summary: Frontend-only verification of new recharts visualizations on Monitor (/commerce/monitor) and the upgraded Verdict gap chart (/commerce/verdict). All 6 Monitor charts and the Verdict FACT 03 chart render with real data marks. Zero JavaScript console errors. All regression elements (stats, activity-table, competitors-week, outreach-button, nav links) intact.

verifications.chart-trajectory: OK — ComposedChart with You area (blue #2d6bff fill), Colmol line (red #e8272a), Saatva line (gray), Purple dashed line, dashed reference at y=62, legend with 4 entries, 4 week ticks WK1-WK4 visible.
verifications.chart-gauge: OK — RadialBarChart with background sector (#1a1a1a) + filled sector (#2d6bff #2d6bff fill, ~169° sweep for 47%). Centered '47' + '+25 THIS WEEK' overlay visible.
verifications.chart-visits: OK — Stacked BarChart 7 days MON..SUN, 21 bar rectangles (3 stacks × 7 days), legend ChatGPT (blue) / Gemini (yellow #f5c842) / Perplexity (gray #888888).
verifications.chart-funnel: OK — Horizontal BarChart with 4 descending bars; LabelList values [23, 14, 6, 3] visible on right; colors blue/blue/yellow/green as defined in code.
verifications.chart-coverage: OK — 5 rows; SPECIALIST bar GREEN (#22c55e, value 71); others RED (#e8272a) with values 12/8/5; LUXURY=0 has label '0' but no rectangle (expected for 0-width bar).
verifications.chart-radar: OK — RadarChart with 2 .recharts-polygon elements: You (stroke/fill #2d6bff) and Rival avg (stroke/fill #e8272a #e8272a). Polar grid (6 axes CRAWLERS/SCHEMA/REVIEWS/FAQ/COMPARISON/CITATIONS) + legend visible.
verifications.verdict-gap-bars: OK — 4 bars with values [62, 58, 51, 22] (labels visible above each bar). Colors: [#2d6bff, #2d6bff, #2d6bff, #e8272a] — Your Store correctly RED, rivals BLUE. Red dashed reference line at y=57 with 'RIVAL AVG 57' label visible.
verifications.verdict-gap-callout: OK — '−40' callout (red border, red text) with 'points behind Saatva · bottom of 5 stores'. Second box: '−35' (white) with 'points under the 57 category benchmark'.
verifications.regression: ai-channel-feed, monitor-stats, activity-table, competitors-week (Colmol 51→65 MOVING UP red pill, Your Store 22→47 FASTEST GROWTH green pill), outreach-button (yellow) all present.
verifications.navigation: MONITOR → AGENT link works (URL changes to /commerce/agent). Active MONITOR nav link computed color = rgb(45, 107, 255) (blue).
verifications.console_errors: 0 errors. No recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings surfaced as errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: chart-coverage bar with score=0 (LUXURY) does not render a colored rect (width=0). Label '0' is shown so the row is identifiable, but a 0-value bar is visually absent. Acceptable, but if a minimum-width hint bar is desired for empty queries, consider rendering a thin baseline marker.

Minor: Monitor.jsx is approaching ~335 lines with multiple inline chart data arrays + JSX. As more charts are added, consider extracting chart configs into a /data file and each ChartCard into its own component for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None — static prototype, all data hardcoded in component files.
